intent.description: Use to investigate, plan, implement, review, or verify non-trivial software engineering where repository or runtime evidence materially affects correctness: complex or intermittent bugs, multi-step features, shared-interface refactors, API/provider integrations, authentication or authorization, payments, database migrations, persistent data, concurrency, CI/CD, deployment, security boundaries, or small edits that control a high-risk boundary. Do not trigger for typos, harmless one-line/local edits, exact symbol lookups, general concept explanations, translation, writing-only work, or brainstorming without a repository/runtime decision.
intent.job_to_be_done: Use to investigate, plan, implement, review, or verify non-trivial software engineering where repository or runtime evidence materially affects correctness: complex or intermittent bugs, multi-step features, shared-interface refactors, API/provider integrations, authentication or authorization, payments, database migrations, persistent data, concurrency, CI/CD, deployment, security boundaries, or small edits that control a high-risk boundary. Do not trigger for typos, harmless one-line/local edits, exact symbol lookups, general concept explanations, translation, writing-only work, or brainstorming without a repository/runtime decision.

should_trigger: Investigate this intermittent bug in the repository, reproduce it, find the root cause, implement one fix, and add a regression test.
Điều tra lỗi ngẫu nhiên trong dự án này, tái hiện, tìm nguyên nhân gốc rồi sửa và kiểm thử hồi quy.
Add a multi-step feature to this codebase after inspecting the architecture, baseline tests, and runtime flow.
Thêm tính năng nhiều bước vào mã nguồn này, kiểm tra kiến trúc và chạy thật trước khi kết luận.
Replace the failed API provider integration in this repository and verify timeout, retry, error schema, and fallback behavior.
Refactor authentication and authorization across the codebase without breaking existing sessions; include unauthorized-path tests.
Tích hợp payment webhook trong repo, kiểm tra idempotency, duplicate delivery, race condition và rollback.
Plan and implement a database migration for persistent data, including legacy compatibility, concurrency, and rollback verification.
Diagnose why CI/CD deployment fails only in production and verify the fix against logs and runtime configuration.
Review this implementation plan for a public API refactor, identify hidden assumptions, compatibility risks, and missing verification.
Xác minh commit này thực sự sửa race condition và không làm hỏng các test cũ hoặc runtime path.
Change one line controlling production billing retry idempotency; inspect the payment flow and verify duplicate behavior.
Sửa một dòng kiểm soát phân quyền production; đọc codebase xung quanh và kiểm thử unauthorized path.
should_not_trigger: Fix this typo in README: teh to the.
Rename this label from Save to Lưu.
Where is the exact symbol BuildFormattedHanViet defined?
Just explain what dependency injection is in general.
Dịch đoạn tiếng Trung này sang tiếng Việt, chỉ dịch.
Writing only: rewrite this email to sound more polite.
Brainstorm only: suggest names for a note-taking app.
Regex đơn giản để xóa dòng trùng trong Notepad++.
Tạo outline kiến trúc chung cho ứng dụng mẫu, chưa có repo hay yêu cầu triển khai.
Plan a generic learning roadmap for software engineering.
near_neighbor: Explain the current filter-name function in this repository.
Run the existing unit test named ParserHandlesEmptyInput and tell me whether it passes.
Set TimeoutSeconds from 10 to 15 in config; no other changes.
Review ngữ pháp README này, không cần xem codebase.
Review nội dung bài blog kỹ thuật này, chỉ viết lại cho dễ đọc.

permissions.network: only when authoritative external documentation or provider evidence is material and allowed
permissions.file_write: only in Implement mode and within user scope
permissions.subprocess: targeted validation, build, test, runtime, diagnostic, and version-control inspection commands
permissions.interactive: only when user authentication or an essential user decision requires it

production: routing description contains positive and negative boundaries
baseline and risk selection are explicit for material work
package validator, trigger eval, and secret scan pass
trigger eval covers should-trigger, should-not-trigger, and near-neighbor cases
risk-proportionate workflow and evidence-bound verification claims
destructive and shared-state actions require approval

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
